paragraphs.text: Empowered by generations of strength.
Experience is a good teacher, not a kind one.
"My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."
"We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more." —Commander Eesha
"Power often costs too high a price." —Commander Eesha
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens." —Mystic elder
"War glides on the simplest updrafts while peace struggles against hurricane winds. It is the way of the world. It must change."
"Raze the body. Raise the soul." —Mystic elder
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
She wished for nobility, but not for a nation to honor it.
"May the Ancestor strengthen my hand and guide my blade." —Nomad war prayer
"Never underestimate our enemy's strength, brutality, . . . or stupidity." —Commander Eesha
Nomads weave tales thicker than tapestries.
"Our unity revives our hopes."
Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.
"Our unity conquers all fears."
A symbol of hope for hopeless times.
It marks the border between here and hereafter.
"Our unity humbles our foes."
"Our forebears once flew like this—carefree, needing nothing but a warm nest and a full belly. Our intellect may be more burden than blessing." —Commander Eesha
"If we have learned nothing else, we have learned to survive." —Mystic elder
"The desert asked the Ancestor for children, and the antelope were born." —Nomad myth
"Only the Ancestor should be revered." —Mystic heretic
"The cracks widened, the shell crumbled, and Valor spread throughout the land." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
"I cover the land with blankets and it sleeps."
Cephalids don't police people. They police loyalties.
Cephalids shrink from the harsh glare of scrutiny.

Magical or not, it's still a cloud.
"What you made will be unmade. What you learned will be unlearned. And when you're done, you will be undone." —Ambassador Laquatus
"Would you abandon your past to save your future?" —Ambassador Laquatus
Scholars possess such lofty knowledge that it shouldn't be surprising when they fall.
"I see their moral dilemmas. I see their raw courage. I see their self-sacrifice. I see our victory."
"The first time was amusing, but now you're getting tiresome."
Some minds are more open than others.
"Breaking it would be about four hundred years bad luck." —Nomad sentry
"The best foresight is hindsight." —Empress Llawan
"Nature's been fired. The oceans are under new management." —Ambassador Laquatus

"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
Spawned by mages emulating the insane.
Chainer's admirers keep his dreams alive.
He remembers enough of his life to weep for what he has lost.
"Ah, a faceshredder. Very rare. Nearly unstoppable. Good luck!" —Cabal instructor

Rats come in one amount: too many.

"You call *that* a nightmare?" —Braids, dementia summoner

"That does it—I quit!" —Cabal grave robber

"Out of my way!"
The wizard's spellbook was full of burning questions.
"Enough!"
"Even the threat of power has power." —Jeska, warrior adept

His battle cry unleashes an avalanche of dwarves.
"Drill the planet, it's no trouble: Mining granite, making rubble." —Dwarven drilling song
Barbarians invented the blaze of glory. Dwarves perfected it.
Dwarves bring poor coal to market, use good coal in their homes, and throw their best coal away.
"I don't rub salt in wounds. I use sulfur." —Matoc, lavamancer

"My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge. Kamahl has a temper of fire. I have a temper of steel."
Freed from their chains, these dwarves are bound only by honor.

When it croaks, so do you.

Nature's strength outlives the strong.
"If our foes will not listen to words, perhaps hooves and claws will make them take notice." —Seton, centaur druid

"We use only what we need—but in times of strife, our need becomes great." —Centaur warrior

"Our unity renews our strength."
